attributes.board_name: Nevada Board of Examiners for Social Workers

rules.accepted_credit_types: Courses approved by the Board or automatically accepted: ASWB ACE; Nevada behavioral boards (Social Workers, Psychological Examiners, MFT & CPC, Alcohol/Drug/Gambling Counselors); NASW (any chapter), AAMFT, APA, NAADAC, NBCC; CEUs approved by any other state's behavioral board; Nevada in-state approved providers
rules.alternatives: Licensees aged 60+ retired from social work practice may ask the Board to waive all but the legislatively mandated CE (suicide prevention, cultural diversity/equity/inclusion).
rules.audit_note: Mandated CEUs (suicide prevention, CDEI) are uploaded at the collection-cycle renewal and audited 100%; ethics is attested; all certificates required only if audited.

topics.who: All; cultural diversity, equity and inclusion, certificate uploaded
All; ethics in social work practice

rules.notes: License renews annually by end of birth month; CE is collected every 2 years on an even- or odd-year cycle shown on license verification. 10 hours must be in the licensee's field of practice. Same course content may not be repeated in the next period.
rules.rule_quote: LSW, LMSW and LASW Requirements Must complete at least 30 continuing education hours every 2 years…
